name: Onyxia's Lair
summary: Deep in the Wyrmbog, magma burns beneath the marsh in Onyxia's Lair. Onyxia keeps her stronghold and nesting place here, watching over clutches of black dragon eggs.

sections.title: A Den of Magma and Ruin
sections.body: The entrance cuts through the Wyrmbog's mud and petrified wood like a dragon's open maw. Beyond it, volcanic heat drives out the marsh's cool rot. Magma seeps through cracks in the obsidian, and tremors often shake the ceilings. In a vast chamber, hundreds of black dragon eggs lie among ash and embers. Flightkin and dragonspawn guards watch the clutch beside Onyxia.

sections.title: The Broodmother's Retreat
sections.body: Onyxia keeps a secluded roost on Kalimdor to breed the next generation of the black dragonflight. Across the sea, her brother Nefarian plots from Blackrock Spire. When her political schemes unravel, the lair offers refuge. Far from mortal courts, Onyxia can cast off her human guises and take her true form as Deathwing's daughter.

faq.answer: Onyxia's Lair lies in southern Dustwallow Marsh, within the Wyrmbog just south of the Dragonmurk. Massive dragon bones and smoldering ground mark the entrance, where black dragonkin guard a stony fissure shaped like an open jaw.

faq.q: What creatures dwell inside the lair?
faq.answer: Members of the black dragonflight dwell in the cavern. Broodmother Onyxia commands its deep chamber among freshly hatched whelps, guardian dragonspawn, and mature black drakes.

faq.q: Why is the cave so hot if it sits in a swamp?
aliases: why is there lava in dustwallow
faq.answer: Onyxia dug deep into Kalimdor's crust and reached subterranean veins of magma. The volcanic heat incubates black dragon eggs, while cold mud covers the marsh above.

faq.q: Why is Onyxia hiding out in Kalimdor?
faq.answer: Dustwallow Marsh gives Onyxia isolation and concealment. Thick fogs, dismal quagmires, and dangerous wildlife keep mortal armies away, letting her replenish her flight undisturbed as she meddles abroad.

angles.text: For Alliance champions, this cavern is the den of a black broodmother whose growing brood threatens Theramore and every settlement around the marsh.
Dustwallow Marsh borders Horde territory in the Barrens and Mulgore. A black broodmother hatching an army of dragons on Kalimdor threatens the whole new Horde.
